name.zh: Oh Story（网文写作 skill 包）

tagline.en: Turn a coding agent into a complete web-fiction writing workflow — chart scanning, deconstruction, drafting, de-AI editing, covers.
tagline.zh: 把编程 Agent 变成完整的网文写作流程——扫榜、拆文、写作、去AI味、封面图。

definition.en: Oh Story is an MIT-licensed creative-writing skill pack for Claude Code and other supported agent hosts. Its 13 skills cover web-fiction research, deconstruction, long-form serials, short stories, revision and covers. It combines writing instructions with chapter blueprints, deterministic checks and file-based project state; it is not a hosted model or a finished-novel guarantee. `/story-setup` configures the host. Specialist-agent orchestration depends on host capabilities, with direct execution available when those capabilities are missing.
definition.zh: 用 Claude Code 写网文可以使用 Oh Story：这是 MIT 开源的创意写作 skill 包，也适配其他受支持的 Agent 宿主。13 个 skills 覆盖选题、拆文、长篇连载、短篇、修订与封面，把写作指令与逐章细纲、确定性检查和文件化项目状态结合起来；它不是托管模型，也不保证直接产出可发表的整本小说。`/story-setup` 负责配置宿主，专业 agent 编排取决于宿主能力，能力缺失时可直接执行。

en: Authors publishing on 起点 Qidian, 番茄 Fanqie, 晋江 JJWXC, 七猫 Qimao and 知乎盐言
Studios running several serials at once
Developers who want a mature, non-coding example of agent skills
zh: 在起点、番茄、晋江、七猫、知乎盐言等平台写作的作者
同时运营多本书的工作室
想看非编程场景下成熟 agent skills 的开发者

en: How do I continue a manuscript I have already written?

Use story-import to reconstruct a writing project, not only an analysis report. Confirm the last complete chapter, review inferred facts and partial drafts, then explicitly request the next chapter. The [import and continuation guide](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/import-and-continue) explains supported inputs, author decisions and the actual project files.
How do I start writing in Claude Code?

After installing the pack, run `/story-setup` in your writing-project folder and open a fresh session. Use `/story` to describe your task rather than memorizing every skill. For a new long-form project, `/story-long-write 帮我开书` prepares settings, an outline and chapter blueprints, then stops before prose by default. Review that plan, then request `/story-long-write 写第1章`. This is the agent-host workflow, not a login to the separate hosted ZenStory workbench.
扫榜 · chart scanning
Collect supported platform data when available, accept creator-supplied samples, or explicitly label historical knowledge fallback; unavailable sources can be skipped.
拆文 · deconstruction
Analyse structure, characters and style, using an opening sample for long-form work; a creator-requested full analysis continues after writing the preview.
How can I reduce character drift across many chapters?

Before each chapter, the workflow checks the last committed chapter, reads its blueprint and relevant character files, and selects current character state, active foreshadowing and next-chapter promises from the derived context. `追踪/_tracking-state.json` is the structured authority; derived views are not a second source of truth. Keep facts outside the chat and review the next chapter against them. These mechanisms make continuity inspectable; they do not prove error-free performance over 100 chapters.
What if a chapter contradicts an established fact?

Identify the conflicting passage and the intended fact, then request `/story-long-write 修改第N章` with that evidence. If the revision changes continuity facts, the documented workflow requires a same-chapter revision transaction through `tracking_commit.py`; do not hand-edit the derived context or snapshots. Review the corrected prose and state before continuing. Structural checks do not replace the author’s judgment about characterization, voice or literary quality.
How can I revise formulaic prose without changing the story?

Name the wording problem, preserve the scene facts and revise only the necessary passages. A pattern hit is a prompt for contextual judgment, not proof of AI authorship. The [original before/after example](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/revise-ai-prose) explains why particular edits help and which facts stay unchanged.
Covers
Prepare genre-aware cover guidance and use an available image-generation tool when configured.
zh: 已经写了十几章，怎么接着写？
先用 story-import 重建写作项目，而不是只生成拆文报告。确认最后完整章，审阅反推事实与残稿，再点名续写下一章。[导入续写指南](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/import-and-continue)说明支持的材料、作者需要决定的事项以及实际工程文件。
Claude Code 装好后，怎么开始写小说？

安装 skill 包后，在写作项目目录运行 `/story-setup`，再新开会话。通过 `/story` 描述任务，不必先记住全部 skill。新建长篇可以说 `/story-long-write 帮我开书`：默认先生成设定、大纲与细纲，在正文前停下。审阅规划后，再明确请求 `/story-long-write 写第1章`。这是 Agent 宿主内的流程，不是登录另一个产品 ZenStory 网页工作台。
扫榜
在条件允许时采集所支持平台的数据，接受作者提供的样本，或明确标注历史知识回退；不可用的数据源可以跳过。
拆文
分析结构、角色与文风，长篇先做开篇样本；作者已要求完整拆解时，写出预览后继续执行。
长篇续写怎样减少人设和情节漂移？
每章写前，流程检查最后已提交章节，读取本章细纲及相关角色文件，并从派生上下文筛选当前角色状态、活跃伏笔和下一章承诺。`追踪/_tracking-state.json` 是结构化权威，派生视图不是第二套事实源。把故事事实留在项目文件里，再用它们核对下一章，而非只依赖长聊天记忆。这些机制让连续性可检查，不代表已证明连续 100 章都不会出错。
发现某一章与既有设定冲突怎么办？
先指出冲突段落和希望保留的事实，再带着依据请求 `/story-long-write 修改第N章`。修订若改变连续性事实，文档规定通过 `tracking_commit.py` 提交同章修订事务，不要手改派生上下文或角色快照。继续写之前核对改后的正文与状态。结构检查不能代替作者对人设、文风和文学质量的判断。
怎么改掉正文的套话和解释腔？
先说清措辞问题，保留场景事实，只改有必要的段落。模式命中需要结合语境判断，不证明文本由 AI 创作。[原创改稿前后对照](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/revise-ai-prose)说明每项修改的理由，以及哪些事实没有改变。
封面
准备题材相关的封面指引，并在配置可用生图工具时调用。

en: Local verifiers check contracts and detectable patterns, rather than assigning literary quality scores.
Project settings, outlines, drafts, references and tracking remain inspectable files.
Host-aware setup can use specialist roles or a direct fallback; supported hosts do not imply identical orchestration.
The repository includes deconstruction, continuation and cover examples, not a guarantee of comparable results.
zh: 本地 verifier 检查契约与可检测模式，不为文学质量打分。
设定、大纲、正文、参考资料与追踪记录均为可检查的文件。
按宿主能力使用专业角色或直接执行回退；支持某个宿主不代表编排能力完全相同。
仓库包含拆文、续写与封面示例，不保证复现同等结果。

name.zh: Drama Skills（AI 短剧 / 漫剧）

tagline.en: Develop ideas or source stories into episode scripts, visual specifications, storyboards and generation prompts, with optional production and review.
tagline.zh: 把点子或原著发展为分集剧本、视觉设定、分镜和生成提示词，按需进入制作与审查。

definition.en: Drama Skills is an eleven-skill workflow for AI short-drama and motion-comic creation in agent hosts such as Claude Code and Codex. Creators can enter at the stage their material needs: development, writing, assets, storyboards, prompts, production, editing or review. Documents are created as needed; prompt/specification work is distinct from generating media, which requires configured providers and explicit spending confirmation.
definition.zh: Drama Skills 是面向 Claude Code、Codex 等 Agent 宿主的 11-skill AI 短剧与漫剧创作工作流。创作者可按材料需要进入开发、写作、资产、分镜、提示词、制作、剪辑或审查阶段。文档按需创建；提示词与规格设计不同于媒体生成，后者需要配置供应商并明确确认消费。

en: Screenwriters
Motion-comic and short-drama studios
Directors and producers working with image/video generation models
zh: 编剧
漫剧 / 短剧工作室
使用图像与视频生成模型的编导、制片

en: Does one novel chapter become one short-drama episode?

Not by default. Plan episodes around a local dramatic result and a clear handoff, preserving source facts and marking proposed changes. Start with a pilot before expanding the series. The [novel-to-short-drama guide](https://zenstory.ai/drama-skills/novel-to-short-drama) shows an original prose-to-scene-and-shots example.
Develop
Create an episode map or genre guidance when needed; a candidate director brief becomes authority only after creator acceptance.
Write
Draft episode scripts with explicit scene goals, opposing forces, turns and exit states.
How do I keep the same character across shots?

Separate persistent identity from the scene’s compatible Look and each shot’s changing hand, prop and gaze state. Carry only the necessary unchanged visual facts as continuity locks. The [three-shot character example](https://zenstory.ai/drama-skills/character-consistency) shows the handoff without pretending a character sheet guarantees generated faces.
Are prompt IDs already image references?

No. `IMG-*` identifies prompt text; `REF-*` binds an inspected real image. A creator-planned `PLAN-*` reference can describe the intended shot but cannot be submitted to `short-drama-produce` before real files are bound. Missing images do not silently authorize text-to-video.
Produce, edit, review
Media generation uses prepare → explicit confirmation → run. Editing and a separately requested review are distinct stages.
zh: 小说改短剧，是不是一章对应一集？
不是默认一一对应。按局部戏剧结果与明确交接来分集，保留原文事实，并标清拟改内容。先试写一集，再扩展整季。[小说改短剧指南](https://zenstory.ai/drama-skills/novel-to-short-drama)用原创片段演示从叙述到场次、镜头的转换。
开发
按需创建分集地图或题材指引；候选导演阐述经创作者接受后才成为权威。
写作
写分集剧本，明确场次目标、对抗力、转折和出口状态。
同一角色跨镜头，怎样减少外观和动作串线？
分开长期人物身份、本场相容造型，以及每镜变化的手位、道具和视线；只有必要且不变的可见事实才作为连续性锁传递。[原创三镜示例](https://zenstory.ai/drama-skills/character-consistency)展示具体交接，不把角色设定表当成生成脸部一致的保证。
有提示词编号，就算已经有参考图了吗？
不是。`IMG-*` 标记提示词正文，`REF-*` 才绑定已检查的真实图片。创作者计划提供的 `PLAN-*` 可以描述预期镜头，但真实文件绑定前不能交给 `short-drama-produce`；缺图也不能静默当成已授权文生视频。
制作、剪辑、审查
媒体生成遵循准备 → 明确确认 → 执行。剪辑与另行请求的审查是独立阶段。

en: An episode can use up to five core creative document types: screenplay, visual bible, storyboard, image prompts and video prompts, created only when needed.
Rule categories distinguish locally provable structural failures from reviewed judgments, craft defaults and taste choices.
Production uses a fingerprint-bound, one-time confirmation; writing prompts alone does not authorize a paid run.
Actual generated or supplied image files must exist and be bound before becoming production references. Continuity constraints do not guarantee visual consistency.
zh: 每集按需使用至多五类核心创作文档：剧本、视觉设定、分镜、图片提示词和视频提示词，不要求提前建齐。
规则分类区分本地可证明的结构失败、需审阅的判断、工艺默认与口味选择。
制作使用与指纹绑定的一次性确认；写好提示词本身不代表授权付费执行。
生成或提供的真实图片文件必须存在并绑定后才能作为制作参考；连续性约束不保证画面一致性。

tagline.en: A source-grounded workflow for adapting novels into playable game candidates on a chosen target runtime.
tagline.zh: 以原文证据为基础，在选定目标运行环境中构建和验证小说改编游戏的候选版本。

definition.en: Novel to Game is a seven-skill workflow for Claude Code, Codex and Kimi Code. It builds a cited source bible, compares adaptation concepts, designs the game and art direction, and builds a candidate for an explicitly chosen target runtime. Its QA contract records evidence for launch, rendering, input, the core loop, an outcome and restart; it does not certify fun, balance or readiness for commercial release.
definition.zh: Novel to Game 是面向 Claude Code、Codex 和 Kimi Code 的 7-skill 工作流。它建立带引用的原著圣经、比较改编概念、设计玩法与美术，并针对明确选定的目标运行环境构建候选版本。QA 契约记录启动、渲染、输入、核心循环、设计结果和重开的证据，不认证趣味性、平衡性或商业发布准备程度。

en: Authors and IP holders who want an interactive edition of a story
Game prototypers
Narrative designers
zh: 想把作品做成互动版本的作者与 IP 方
游戏原型开发者
叙事设计师

en: Can I make an interactive story rather than a combat game?
Yes: set a narrative-led experience in the brief and concept. Decisions can change testimony, what characters know and later scenes; they need not be disguised as cards, turns or an affinity meter.
How do choices change more than the wording?

Give each important action a lasting fact and name the later scene or ending that reads it. The [original ferry example](https://zenstory.ai/novel-to-game/meaningful-choices) shows two decision points and three outcomes without branching every paragraph.
What may I change from the novel?

Keep cited source facts and uncertainties in `analysis/SOURCE_BIBLE.md`. Separate approved adaptation additions from evidence; do not let implementation silently rewrite the agreed brief or source bible.
How much should I adapt first?

Start with one player role, a concrete objective, a few scenes and an outcome. Let `game-world-design` specify the smallest playable slice and causal design before full art production. Reuse a location without erasing the choices that led there.
What do I receive, and what remains unproven?

The [quick start](https://zenstory.ai/novel-to-game/quick-start) explains the brief, design files and built candidate. Design-only work is not a playable game. The six runtime checks cover the recorded run; they do not establish every branch, subjective quality or commercial readiness.
zh: 我想做互动文游，不想做战斗游戏，可以吗？
可以，在简报与概念阶段选择叙事主导体验。决定可以改变证词、人物知道的信息和后续场景，不必包装成卡牌、回合或好感度条。
怎样避免选择只换一句文案？
让关键行动产生持久事实，并写明后续哪个场景或结局会读取它。[原创渡口示例](https://zenstory.ai/novel-to-game/meaningful-choices)用两个选择点、三个结果演示，不需要每段正文都分叉。
原著可以改到什么程度？
在 `analysis/SOURCE_BIBLE.md` 保留带出处的事实和疑点，把批准的改编新增设定与原文证据分开。实现阶段不能悄悄改写已确定的产品简报或原著圣经。
第一次应该改编多大范围？
先限定一个玩家身份、具体目标、少量场景和结果。在完整美术生产前，由 `game-world-design` 明确最小可玩切片与因果设计。地点可以复用，但到达该地点之前的选择不能被抹掉。
最后会拿到什么，什么还不能证明？
[完整入门指南](https://zenstory.ai/novel-to-game/quick-start)说明简报、设计文件与构建候选版本。只做设计不等于可玩游戏。六项运行检查只覆盖所记录的一次运行，不代表每条分支、主观质量或商业发布准备程度都已通过。

definition.en: Video Recap Skills is five independent skills plus a thin orchestrator for Claude Code: six skills in total. It uses ffmpeg with remote MiMo services for ASR, visual understanding and default TTS; Fish Audio is an optional TTS provider. The workflow can produce a narrated recap and optionally export an editable CapCut/JianYing draft. Final delivery still requires full playback review, not only automated QC.
definition.zh: Video Recap Skills 面向 Claude Code，由 5 个独立 skill 加一个轻量编排器组成，总计 6 个 skills。它使用 ffmpeg，并通过远程 MiMo 服务完成 ASR、视觉理解和默认 TTS；Fish Audio 是可选的 TTS 服务。工作流可以制作解说视频，也可以导出可编辑的剪映草稿。最终交付仍需完整播放复核，不能只依赖自动 QC。

en: Recap and commentary channel creators
Editors who finish in CapCut
Teams turning long footage into short narrated cuts
zh: 影视解说 / 说剧类创作者
在剪映里精修的剪辑师
把长素材做成短解说的团队

en: How do I turn a local video into a Chinese recap?

Build a scene/dialogue evidence index, choose the audience promise, divide the work between pictures, original audio and narration, then voice and assemble the grounded script. The [complete workflow guide](https://zenstory.ai/video-recap/video-to-narration) explains full/cut choices, stage handoffs and expected files before optional draft export.
Which moments should keep their original sound?

Keep dialogue that is itself an event, an action sound that reveals a change, or a meaningful pause. Add narration only for a supported job the picture and source audio cannot do. The [five-beat radio example](https://zenstory.ai/video-recap/original-audio-and-narration) shows the division without requiring a fixed narration ratio.
Can I write the recap before choosing the cut?

Decide the story and sound roles first. In the orchestrated cut flow, select source clips, then write narration against the actual edited output timeline. Do not copy original timestamps into that output-time narration.
What if the voiceover is too long?
Reduce or move the thought instead of speaking over the next protected line. Bounded speed adjustment is not unlimited; an unsafe fit can block placement rather than clipping the spoken ending.
Does an audio-owner label automatically preserve the mix?

No. The renderer does not parse the creative board. Actual narration timing, speech evidence and mix settings implement the plan; source audio can remain ducked beyond the written block until a safe recovery point. Listen to the rendered handoff.
Can I finish the sound and captions manually?

After the real timeline exists, use the [JianYing / CapCut draft guide](https://zenstory.ai/video-recap/capcut-draft) to export an editable bundle without rerunning remote stages, then review audio handoffs and audible original-dialogue captions in your editor.
zh: 怎样把本地视频做成中文解说？
先建立场景与对白证据索引，再确定观众承诺，分配画面、原声与旁白的职责，之后为有依据的文案配音、合成。[完整流程指南](https://zenstory.ai/video-recap/video-to-narration)说明 full/cut 选择、阶段交接和预期文件，再按需导出草稿。
哪些地方应该保留原声？
对白本身就是事件、动作声让人听见变化，或者停顿有意义时，让原声主导。只有画面和原声做不到的、有依据的任务才交给旁白。[收音机五拍示例](https://zenstory.ai/video-recap/original-audio-and-narration)展示分工，不要求固定的旁白比例。
可以先写好旁白，再随便剪画面吗？
先明确故事与声音职责。编排式 cut 流程先选原片片段，再针对实际剪后输出时间线写旁白，不能直接把原片时间戳抄进输出时间的旁白稿。
配音太长，放不进窗口怎么办？
先删减或移动这段意思，不要抢下一句须保留原话的位置。受限变速不等于无限加速；无法安全放入时可阻断放置，而不是裁掉尾音。
写了声音职责标签，就能自动保住原声吗？
不能。渲染器不解析创意 board，需要实际旁白时间、对白证据与混音设置落实；原声可能在书面段落结束后仍被压低，直到安全恢复点。要听渲染后的真实交接。
可以再手动精修声音和字幕吗？
真实时间轴已存在时，可按[剪映 / CapCut 草稿指南](https://zenstory.ai/video-recap/capcut-draft)导出可编辑媒体包，不重跑远程阶段；再在编辑器里精修声音交接与实际可听见的原声对白字幕。

definition.en: Oh Story DSH is a community plugin for DeepSeek Harness that bundles pinned versions of Oh Story, Drama Skills, Novel to Game and Video Recap Skills, with novel, short-drama, game and video workbenches. It runs in a local DSH environment, whose model and media services need separate configuration; it is not an offline model bundle. The plugin package is `@oh-story/dsh`. It is not affiliated with, partnered with or endorsed by DeepSeek.
definition.zh: Oh Story DSH 是 DeepSeek Harness 的社区插件，打包固定版本的 Oh Story、Drama Skills、Novel to Game 与 Video Recap Skills，并提供小说、短剧、游戏和视频工作台。它运行于本地 DSH 环境，模型和媒体服务需要另行配置，不是离线模型包。插件包名为 `@oh-story/dsh`。本项目与 DeepSeek 无隶属、合作或背书关系。

en: DeepSeek Harness users
Creators who prefer a GUI over slash commands

偏好图形界面而非斜杠命令的创作者

en: Install

Follow the versioned installation guide: Node.js 24+, pnpm-assisted plugin installation in a DSH Web profile, then start DSH Web. Installing the creation plugin alone does not add a Web UI to a fresh profile.
Configure
Configure a model for AI creation and only the media providers you use. Video processing additionally requires Python and ffmpeg/ffprobe.
Open
Choose a workspace and session. Creation tabs appear when project files exist; an empty workspace retains native DSH Chat.
zh: 安装
按版本化安装指南准备 Node.js 24+，用附带 pnpm 的命令将插件安装到 DSH Web profile，再启动 DSH Web。只安装创作插件不会给全新的 profile 添加网页界面。
配置
为 AI 创作配置模型，并仅配置需要的媒体服务；视频处理还需要 Python 与 ffmpeg/ffprobe。
打开
选择工作目录与会话。存在创作项目文件后显示对应工作台；空目录保留原生 DSH Chat。

tagline.en: Chat to create — an agent-driven novel-writing workbench that keeps files, materials, characters, chapters and versions in one place.
tagline.zh: 对话即创作——以文件为中心的 AI 小说写作工作台：素材、人设、章节、版本都在一处。

definition.en: ZenStory is the hosted, conversation-first member of the family: a three-panel workbench (file tree, editor, AI chat) where outlines, drafts, characters and lore are files, and a multi-agent backend drafts, suggests and revises against them. It ships its own skills and an Agent API for Claude Code and OpenClaw, is self-hostable (MIT), and is available as a service at app.zenstory.ai with free and paid plans.
definition.zh: ZenStory 是这个家族里托管的、对话优先的成员：三栏工作台（文件树、编辑器、AI 对话），大纲、草稿、人设、世界观都是文件，多 agent 后端围绕它们写作、建议与修订。自带 skills 与面向 Claude Code / OpenClaw 的 Agent API，可自托管（MIT），也提供 app.zenstory.ai 的在线服务与免费/付费方案。

en: Novelists who want a workspace rather than a terminal
Writers managing long projects with version history
zh: 想要工作区而不是终端的小说作者
需要版本历史管理长篇项目的写作者

en: How do I start writing in the browser?

Open the [workbench Dashboard](https://app.zenstory.ai/dashboard), choose an available project type and create it with or without an idea. For a deliberate first request, leave the idea blank and then ask for an outline in chat. Follow the [short quick start](https://zenstory.ai/docs/getting-started/quick-start); no coding-agent installation is required.
How do I turn an idea into my first scene?

Separate approved facts from open decisions, save characters and a scene plan, then draft into a named file. The [first-story walkthrough](https://zenstory.ai/docs/getting-started/first-project) includes an original lost-property premise, file plan and three scoped requests, not a recorded model run.
How do I revise without changing the whole story?

Open the target file, name the references to read and quote the passage. Attach material items when relevant. The [AI assistant guide](https://zenstory.ai/docs/user-guide/ai-assistant) explains context and continuation; the [editor guide](https://zenstory.ai/docs/user-guide/editor) shows a local before/after revision. An instruction to suggest changes is not enforced read-only mode, and file operations do not all use per-change approval.
Can I take the manuscript out of the workbench?

The [manuscript export guide](https://zenstory.ai/docs/user-guide/export) explains combined TXT from saved draft/script files, chapter ordering and a separate review copy. It is not a backup of characters, materials, chat or history. Use the [version guide](https://zenstory.ai/docs/user-guide/version-history) to distinguish file recovery from project snapshots; keep important originals independently.
zh: 不用编程 Agent，怎样在网页里开始写作？
打开[工作台 Dashboard](https://app.zenstory.ai/dashboard)，选择可用项目类型，可以带灵感创建，也可以留空后自己发送第一条构思请求。[快速入门](https://zenstory.ai/docs/getting-started/quick-start)给出这条短路径，不需要先安装编程 Agent。
怎样把一个点子变成第一场正文？
先区分确定事实与待定决定，保存人物和场景提纲，再写入指定正文文件。[第一篇短篇教程](https://zenstory.ai/docs/getting-started/first-project)提供原创失物招领故事、文件安排和三段范围明确的请求；示例不是实际模型运行记录。
怎样局部改稿，不把整篇故事改掉？
打开目标文件，命名需要读取的依据，引用问题段落；相关素材可附加到对话。[AI 创作助手](https://zenstory.ai/docs/user-guide/ai-assistant)说明上下文与接续，[编辑器指南](https://zenstory.ai/docs/user-guide/editor)给出局部修改前后对照。“只给建议”不是强制只读模式，也不是所有文件操作都有逐项批准界面。
能把作品带出工作台吗？
[稿件导出指南](https://zenstory.ai/docs/user-guide/export)说明已保存正文与剧本的 TXT 合并、章节排序和另存送审副本；这不是包含人物、素材、聊天和历史的完整备份。[版本指南](https://zenstory.ai/docs/user-guide/version-history)区分单文件恢复与项目快照，重要原稿仍需独立保留。

en: Files are the core unit; version snapshots, comparison and rollback support revision without promising unlimited retention of every edit.

The published privacy policy says content is not used for general model training by default and describes third-party AI processing; this is a policy statement, not an independent infrastructure audit.
The hosted browser workbench is distinct from the agent skill packs; self-hosting still requires configuring the backend and model services.
zh: 以文件为核心，版本快照、比较与回滚支持修订，但不承诺无限保留每次编辑。
已发布隐私政策声明内容默认不用于通用模型训练，并说明第三方 AI 处理；这是政策声明，不是独立基础设施审计。
托管网页工作台不同于 Agent skill 包；自托管仍需配置后端与模型服务。
